Description:
The kasbah is located in the heart of the Draa Valley, between the larger cities of Zagora (51 km away) and Agdz (42 km away). Guests will find shops, restaurants and bars in the centre of Zagora, and there is a bus station around 10 minutes' drive from the hotel. The area is very well known due to the historic kasbah.

This charming castle, dating from the 18th century, is the only historic caÃ¯dale kasbah in the Draa Valley to be restored and transformed into a hotel. Facilities available to guests at the family-friendly eco hotel include a lobby with currency exchange facilities and a cloakroom, restaurant, car park and a bicycle hire service. There are 10 guest rooms in total.

The rooms of the kasbah are decorated in colourful, traditional Moroccan styles. Some of them have a nice view of the village and palm groves, and all have a private bathroom with a shower. A double or king-size bed also features in all rooms as standard.

There is an outdoor swimming pool with a separate children's swimming area and a poolside snack bar, and sun loungers are laid out for guests to use. Guests may also explore the surrounding area by bike (fees apply). The kasbah offers a number of excursions, including 4X4 trips, camel rides, visits to the beautiful countryside and nights spent in bivouacs in the desert (fees apply).

The kasbah offers traditional meals made from seasonal natural produce, with a continental breakfast served each morning and set menu options for lunch and dinner in the typical restaurant.

From Ouarzazate and Marrakech, by car, bus or taxi, guests must take the road to Zagora and after the city of Agdz continue for 42 km. The kasbah is on the main road (exactly 1 km after the Afriquia petrol station).

The city centre and restaurants can be found within around 5 km of the establishment. Marrakech is about 190 km away, and both the bus station and Ouarzazate Airport are around 35 km from the hotel.

This comfortable, family-friendly bed and breakfast offers 10 rooms and reflects the style of the surrounding architecture. Built from adobe, it comprises an interior courtyard and four towers. Authenticity and simplicity are the order of the day in this splendid guesthouse. All guests will enjoy its intimate, calm, relaxing atmosphere and the familiar surroundings. It also offers air conditioning, heating, open spaces and intimate corners. A lobby, TV lounge, Internet access and a car park are also provided.

All rooms have an en suite shower and individually regulated air conditioning.

Guests may take a dip in the heated swimming pool.

Description:
The charming hotel is located 35 km north of Ouarzazate and 5 km from the Ksar of Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, on the Telouet-Asfalou road. The family-friendly hotel is very well situated for excursions, allowing guests to visit the Kasbah of Ait Ben Haddou and the many beautiful Berber villages. The riad also organises trips on foot and by mule, and trips to the deep south of Morocco. Guests will find restaurants and links to the public transport network in Ait Ben Haddou, and they will need to travel to Ouarzazate for shops, bars, nightlife and the bus station. Telouet is approximately 50 km from the hotel and Marrakech is around 163 km away. Ouarzazate Airport is roughly 37 km from the hotel.

This hotel has a bar and a restaurant serving traditional Moroccan cuisine and mint tea. Facilities available to guests at the 12-room establishment include 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, WLAN Internet access and a car park.

The rooms are very comfortable and quiet, and feature traditional furniture, an en suite bathroom with shower or bath and toilet, a double bed, individually regulated air conditioning and heating, and a private terrace. Sheets and towels are provided.

Guests can take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool and relax on the sun terrace using the sun loungers and parasols provided while taking in the magnificent panoramic views of the river and the countryside.

Take the road from Ouarzazate to Ait Ben Haddou, then continue towards Tamdakht. Guests will find the well-known hotel on the right-hand side in an excellent location next to the river, around 3 km outside Ait Ben Haddou.

Description:
HotelDescription#Situated at the foot of the Atlas Mountains in the great valley of the Dades, exactly 27 km from Boumalene, the hotel is a place of real peace. Its unique location makes it an exceptional place for exploring the area on foot, by bike or 4x4. Winter and summer, each season has its charm. The nearest public transport and bus terminal, shopping and tourist facilities can be found in Boumalene, around 27 km away. The Dades Gorge is about 3 km away. The Valley of Roses is around 27 km away, Todra Gorge is some 95 km away, and Tinghir is approximately 80 km from the hotel. Ouarzazate and Ouarzazate Airport are some 140 km away.

The hotel, which was renovated in 2009, is a charming property with a large terrace overlooking the River Dades where guests can have breakfast. The hotel offers all comforts in its 29 rooms. It also offers a camping space at the edge of the river, with all the necessary comforts for campers such as electricity, sanitary facilities and hot showers. Facilities at the hotel include a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a cloakroom, TV lounge, restaurant, car park and bicycle hire service (for a fee).

The rooms have a shower, WC, double or king-size bed and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Some of them are built in the purest Berber tradition and have a private balcony overlooking the River Dades. There are all types of accommodation and suites for families with children.

Sun parasols are provided. For individuals or groups, the hotel also provides transportation in a 4x4 or minibus to explore the region. The hotel organises private tours, hiking and mountain biking (for a fee).

This air-conditioned hotel, which was renovated in 2009, is a charming hotel located in the heart of the Dades Gorge. The hotel is renowned for the quality and originality of its cuisine prepared with fresh products. The hotel offers the possibility of breakfast buffet, lunch and dinner à la carte.

The beach hotel is ideally located on the Corniche of Ain-Diab and offers great views of the Atlantic Ocean and the Hassan II Mosque. The hotel offers an outdoor freshwater swimming pool with a sun terrace and sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use. The nearby beach is sandy.

The hotel restaurant serves a varied range of Moroccan and international cuisine. Buffets are served for breakfast, lunch and dinner, and à la carte options are also available for lunch and dinner.

Description:
The Riad boasts of a fabulous location right in the middle of Essaouira's old town and offers you a magnificent view of the sea and is just 5 minutes from the beach, the harbour and Medina.

This 2-storey guesthouse exudes a warm atmosphere combined with refined luxury. The 5-room establishment offers subtle comfort and an exceptional quality of service, inviting guests to relax and find well-being. Further amenities include showers, Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities, individually regulated air conditioning and terraces.

The guesthouse features a swimming pool and a rooftop sun terrace with parasols. Guests can indulge in a spa treatment or massage for a fee, or just relax on the wind-protected terrace. The nearby beach is sandy.

This establishment offers half-board stays. A light continental breakfast, created by the excellent Samarcande chef, is served daily on the terrace, whilst lunch and dinner can be selected from the a la carte and set menus.

Description:
With a mix of traditional Moroccan arquitecture, design and modern technology our stunning Riad Hostel is situated in the exciting Medina of Fes with easy access for taxis and car parking in a safe neighbourhood, close to Batha Fountain. The views from the roof terraces are simply mind blowing and you can see all the way to the Merenid Tombs.

All rooms have reversible AC/ Heating and the wifi is fibre optic and very fast. The Riad is social and busy and predominantly caters for under 40s - the vibe is fun, upbeat and we regularly hold events and activities. Noise carries in the Riad old building so we are not suitable if you are looking for a silent retreat or are a mature family with children.

Our aim is affordable budget tourism and we serve the best brunch on the terrace in Morocco included in the price from 09:30

Riad Verus also regularly serves a family dinner for all the guests to come together on the roof top terrace with views of the Medina and in Winter in the traditional arabesque courtyard. In the evenings the guests enjoy playing cards or board games or smoking a sheisha in the terrace lounge areas.

The multilingual team at Riad Verus can help organise activities such as camel trekking in the Sahara desert, day trips to Chefchaoen, Meknes, Middle Atlas, Airport transfers and Medina walking tours with great guides.

We have 8 bedrooms in total and 3 of them are dorms. The fine print details tourism restrictions for unmarried couples (where one or both is muslim) and dorms are exclusively for international tourists in order to comply with the law. If you are muslim you will need to present your marriage certificate; If you are both not muslim this rule does not apply to you.

Moroccans or Algerians due to the strict hospitality laws of cosharing rooms are prohibited from booking this property. All guests must provide their working whatsapp number and correct postal code and nationality of the passport entering Morocco and all reservations will be authorised before arrival, if you fail the check the reservation will be cancelled. Please inform Riad Verus in advance of your expected arrival time. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly with the contact details provided in your confirmation.
Guests are required to show a photo identification and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply.
Payment before arrival via bank transfer is required. The property will contact you after you book to provide instructions.
Guests under the age of 18 can only check in with a parent or official guardian.
In accordance with Moroccan law, nationals from Muslim countries CAN NOT stay in the same bedroom as the opposite sex so IF you have booked a bed in a dorm you will need to cancel it immediately. Additionally, marriage papers are required for nationals from Muslim countries to stay in private rooms with someone of the opposite sex. No exceptions.

3 Euros tax per person per night is charged on your booking as a supplement above 2 years old.

If your reservation is over 100 Euros you will need to pay in advance by bank transfer, bizum, monzo, ING, BACS, N26, Wise or by virtual card in order for the reservation to be honored. Please contact us for banking details.

Please note that for guests arriving between 00:00-08:30 there will be an additional charge of 100 Dirham per person payable in cash to the member of staff waiting up for you and your arrival time must be notified to us by email, thank you.

Description:
Khouribga, the capital of the Phosphates, lies in the very heart of the economic region of central Morocco, to the west of the Middle Atlas Mountains. The city enjoys an environment conducive to eco-tourism through its diverse fauna and flora. Khouribga is well-connected with other urban centres of Morocco by rail and road. Guests will find restaurants, bars and nightlife in the immediate vicinity and shops and the bus and train station are approximately 1 km away. Nearby places of interest include the Beni Zemmour biological and ecological site and the Boubagra retention dam (both around a 40-minute drive) as well as the El Khatouat oak forest and the Bouacila Gazelle Reserve (both approximately 30 minutes by car). The business hotel is less than a one-hour drive from Mohamed V International Airport.

This entirely renovated hotel mixes classical concepts with modern interior design. The hotel offers 75 luxuriously conceived and equipped guest rooms, in order to offer a pleasant atmosphere, and welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom and lift access. Further facilities include a newspaper stand, hairdressing salon, TV lounge, children's playground, kids' club and a café, bar, disco and a restaurant. Guests may also make use of the conference facilities, WLAN Internet access, room and laundry services, and a car park.

The hotel rooms feature tasteful decor with modern colours and rich furnishings. Each room has a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower, a twin or single bed, TV, high-speed Internet, an in-room safe, minibar, telephone and individually regulated air conditioning and heating.

The hotel offers an indoor swimming pool with children's swimming area, poolside snack bar and a sun terrace with parasols. It also provides a gym, tennis court, steam room, hammam and a room for massages and spa treatments.

Description:
The camp is conveniently situated in a small village called Erg Lihoudi amidst large sand dunes. M'Hamid El Ghizlane, with its restaurants, shops and links to the public transport network, is approximately 30 km from the family-friendly themed hotel, and the larger city of Zagora in the south-east of Morocco, with its bars and bus station, is around 80 km away. The sand dunes are just a one-minute walk from the camp and the Valley of Draa is approximately a 30-minute drive.

A 4x4 will take guests to the camp, which is located next to huge sand dunes from which they can enjoy an unforgettable sunset or sunrise. The camp consists of very comfortable nomad tents with lovely Bedouin decoration. Renovated in 2009, the charming camp offers a lobby, bar and car park.

The tents are nomad tents with all the comforts, such as beds, mattresses, sheets and blankets. They are decorated with beautiful Berber carpets. There is a modern sanitary block with showers and toilets nearby.

The camp can arrange desert safaris, quad biking, trekking or camel rides.

The camp offers bed and breakfast, as well as half-board and full-board stays with a buffet if the number of guests exceeds 20 persons. Set menu lunch and dinner are available.

To get to the camp, the meeting is at the guest house Chez Le Pacha which is located in M'Hamid El Ghizlane, where the driver of the 4x4, will be happy to drive customers to the camp which is not accessible with small cars, because it is located in the desert.

Description:
The camp is located 30 km away from M'Hamid El Ghizlane city, where there is a public bus station but in order to reach the camp a 4x4 vehicle with a driver is necessary as it is in the desert. The Erg Chegaga is very well known and a famous desert marathon that takes place each year passes through this place whilst lovers of the desert meet there. Ouarzazate Airport is approximately 280 km from the camp.

The camp is located in sand dunes. It is a magical place, and a haven of peace and quiet away from all the stresses of the world, where guests can relax, go on walks and go on camel rides. At night this place becomes something else, when everyone gathers around the campfire to enjoy the music of the nomads and join them to play or just contemplate the starry sky. The charming family-friendly camp was renovated in 2009 and has a total of 30 tents. There is a restaurant and a car park on site.

Description:
Situated just 20 minutes away from the buzzing Marrakech, Kasbah Agafay is nested into a majestic environment and offers a refined and elegant accommodation. You will find a huge outside Pool, Spa and a traditional Hamman. You can relax during our Yoga classes, discover the secrets of the Moroccan gastronomy with our cooking classes led by Bouchra, our traditional cook with gold in her hands.  Be tempted by the discovery of the countryside on foot, on horseback, on camel or with a quad.  
Our rooms and suites are decorated with love. They associate the traditional moroccan architecture with a contemporary twist. Some of our rooms have a private terrace with a view onto the Atlas Mountain. Our humble house reflects the richness of the history of Moroccan architecture and traditions and is a real part of the local patrimony. You will be hosted as a friend and our team will make every effort to ensure your comfort and peace.
Our biggest pleasure will be to please you. There is no schedule at Kasbah Agafay. You are free to take your meals whenever you like; either in our restaurant Al Ourda, on the pool side or on one of our terrace. You will feel at home with us. You can also combine a few nights at the Kasbah with our sister property Ksour Agafay located into the Medina, a few minutes from the Jamaa el Fna market place. You will be able to take advantage of the excitement of the city and the quietness of the country.

Description:
HotelDescription#The hotel is located in the heart of the medina, ideally placed for visitors wishing to explore the souks and historic sites of Marrakech. Restaurants and nightspots are within close reach, while the bus station is just 5 minutes' walk away and Marrakech train station is about 10 minutes away by public transport. Djemaa el Fna Square and Ben Youssef Madrasa are both around 10 minutes' walk away, the Majorelle Garden is some 15 minutes, and the Saadian Tombs can be reached with a half-hour walk or 10 minutes by public transport. The centre of the modern city of Gueliz is around 15 km away and Marrakech-Menara Airport is around 6 km from the hotel.

Originally a palace within in the old medina, this is an exclusive and traditional guest house in the heart of Marrakech, Morocco. Located in a quiet side street, the hotel features one of the highest rooftop terraces in Marrakech, with ample lounge space to sunbathe on a deckchair, refresh in the plunge pool, or sip a tea while gazing at the Old City skyline. A refreshing fountain stands in the centre of the garden patio on the ground floor, where guests will enjoy the restaurant's traditional cuisine, shaded by palm trees and banana plants. Facilities at the hotel include a lobby with 24-hour check-out service and hotel safe, a café, bar and restaurant. Internet access is available, and a laundry service is offered.

The hotel provides quiet, spacious rooms which will give guests a feeling of harmony. The rooms open onto a majestic patio with a pool surrounded by banana and palm trees. The en suite bathroom is fitted with a shower/bath and hairdryer. Additional in-room amenities include double or king-size beds, a safe and tea and coffee making facilities. Individually regulated air conditioning and central heating ensure guests' comfort.

HotelDescription#The hotel is located in splendid, green district of the modern Gueliz city just 5 minutes from the famous Majorell Gardens and the towering walls that surround the old centre, the medina. It is 10 minutes to Djemaa el Fna market square and the palm tree plantation.

The entirely renovated hotel offers a pleasant blend of the traditional and the modern. Providing a relaxing, serene ambience and enchanting Moroccan style, the hotel is ideal for those taking a holiday, being conveniently accessible, lying along a main road. The air-conditioned historical hotel comprises 120 rooms of which 3 are junior suites and 5 are suites. Amongst the facilities count a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a safe and a currency exchange bureau in addition to a hairdressing salon, a bar, a pub, a nightclub, 2 restaurants and conference facilities. Room and laundry services are available and there is a car park for those arriving by car. Younger guests may participate in the kids' club activities.

The agreeably decorated rooms all come with an en suite bathroom, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a radio, a minibar, individually controllable air conditioning, a sitting area and a balcony or terrace.

There is a swimming pool with a children's paddling area and a snack bar in the outdoor complex. Further leisure options include a Jacuzzi, a sauna and an in-house gym. There is also a massage service to take advantage of.

Guests may select their breakfast and evening meal from ample buffets; lunch may alternatively be selected from a menu. It is possible to book a half-board, full-board or bed and breakfast only stay.

A minibar, tea and coffee making facilities and a washing machine provide added convenience. Individually regulated air conditioning and individually regulated heating are standard features in all accommodation and all rooms have their own balcony or terrace.

Guests can take a dip in the hotel's outdoor swimming pool and refreshments are available at the poolside snack bar. Guests can also use the sauna, or play tennis or pool/snooker.

The hotel offers restaurants with Moroccan and international specialities. A continental breakfast is also offered, with buffet and à la carte options at lunch and à la carte and set menu options at dinner.

Description:
HotelDescription#The hotel is some 37 km from the city of Ouarzazate in the Skoura area, a very well known place because of its famous Palmeraie and the famous kasbah of Ameridhil. Ouarzazate Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 37 km.

Built in 1811, this hotel gives guests the charm of Dades in one of the rooms. The hotel offers transfers to and from the property (with fee). The staff are at guests' disposal to help enjoy all the opportunities. Comprising 10 guest rooms, the establishment features a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, a cloakroom, a TV lounge, a restaurant, a car park and a garage.

The hotel offers rooms with a hairdryer and Internet access. The rooms are with traditional furniture and an en suite bathroom with toilet and shower. They are very quiet and some of them have individually regulated air conditioning and heating and a balcony with a nice view of the river and the Palmeraie. Rooms with either double or king-size beds are available.

The hotel offers the possibility to go for a stroll in the Palmeraie or a camel ride (for a fee), or guests can take lessons in Moroccan cuisine (free). Parasols may be hired on the pebble beach. Guests can organise their stay in complete freedom, with visits to the Palmeraie of Ouarzazate, Dades Gorges, 4X4 rides, quad rides or trekking.

The hotel offers the possibility of continental breakfast, lunch and dinner with menu choices. Furthermore, the charming hotel offers an intimate breakfast on the terraces, lunch under the tent or a candlelight dinner under the stars.

From Ouarzazate, take the Skoura road and 37 km later guests will find the hotel sign on the left. Then take a path into the village of Oulad Marzoug. 2 km later they will arrive at the hotel.

Description:
The kasbah is located in the Palmeraie of Skoura, a very well known area between the High Atlas and Sargho mountains, 40 km from Ouarzazate and 240 km from Marrakech. Links to the public transport network are around 2 km away. Ouarzazate Airport is situated approximately 40 km from the hotel.

Built in the 50s, the hotel was completely restored in 2010. The Moroccan living room, dining room, TV room and bar are distributed around the patio and fountain like a riad. The kasbah offers all the facilities and the utmost in comfort. The air-conditioned establishment comprises 12 guest rooms and welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities on offer to guests include a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom, a café, a restaurant, wireless Internet access and room service. Laundry service is available for a fee and those arriving by car may leave their vehicle in the car park.

The rooms are decorated in a Moroccan style. They offer a view over the Atlas Mountains, palm trees, desert and gardens. They are equipped with individually regulated air conditioning and heating, with a private bathroom, shower and toilet. Rooms with either double or king-size beds are available and the rooms have a terrace.

The kasbah offers a 12x6 metre outdoor swimming pool with a mini pool for children. Refreshments are served at the poolside snack bar. Sun loungers and parasols are laid out on the sun terrace for use. In the garden there is a ping pong table. Petanque/bocce is also offered free of charge. Nearby, a horse riding club and quad bike hire are available (for a fee).

The kasbah offers a restaurant combining French and Moroccan cuisine prepared with local produce from the garden. It offers continental breakfast, set menu lunch and dinner, and special dietary meals.

Description:
HotelDescription#The hotel is some 37 km from the city of Ouarzazate in the Skoura area, a very well known place because of its famous Palmeraie and the famous kasbah of Ameridhil. Ouarzazate Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 37 km.

Built in 1811, this hotel gives guests the charm of Dades in one of the rooms. The hotel offers transfers to and from the property (with fee). The staff are at guests' disposal to help enjoy all the opportunities. Comprising 10 guest rooms, the establishment features a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, a cloakroom, a TV lounge, a restaurant, a car park and a garage.

The hotel offers rooms with a hairdryer and Internet access. The rooms are with traditional furniture and an en suite bathroom with toilet and shower. They are very quiet and some of them have individually regulated air conditioning and heating and a balcony with a nice view of the river and the Palmeraie. Rooms with either double or king-size beds are available.

The hotel offers the possibility to go for a stroll in the Palmeraie or a camel ride (for a fee), or guests can take lessons in Moroccan cuisine (free). Parasols may be hired on the pebble beach. Guests can organise their stay in complete freedom, with visits to the Palmeraie of Ouarzazate, Dades Gorges, 4X4 rides, quad rides or trekking.

The hotel offers the possibility of continental breakfast, lunch and dinner with menu choices. Furthermore, the charming hotel offers an intimate breakfast on the terraces, lunch under the tent or a candlelight dinner under the stars.

From Ouarzazate, take the Skoura road and 37 km later guests will find the hotel sign on the left. Then take a path into the village of Oulad Marzoug. 2 km later they will arrive at the hotel.

Description:
This hotel lies at the heart of the Skoura palm grove, 2 km from the centre of Skoura with its restaurants, links to the public transport network and Kasbah Amerhidil. The location is a beautiful quiet spot which is visited by thousands of tourists every year. It lies just 40 km from the city of Ouarzazate, where guests will find bars and nightspots, shops, the tourist centre and the Kelaa M'Gouna (the Valley of the Roses). It is 100 km to the Gorges Dades and 150 km to Tinghir. Ouarzazate Airport is 40 km away.

The hotel is a farm guesthouse which offers good service and good food, with all the vegetables coming from the organic farm, which also keeps chickens and sheep. This family-friendly country house property was renovated in 2010, and comprises a total of 9 rooms. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a cloakroom, a restaurant and a car park.

The rooms are spacious, decorated in a traditional style, and all of them have a private bathroom with shower and WC and offer a double bed.

The region offers many activities and excursions such as camel and horse riding (charges apply), trekking or discovering the unique countryside, including the kasbah, the valleys and the dunes.

The cuisine served at this establishment is typically Moroccan fare, prepared using fresh produce from the farm, and includes couscous, tagines and pastries. A continental breakfast is served, and lunch and dinner are available from a set menu.

Guests coming from Ouarzazate should take the road to Tinghir and follow the signs to the property when arriving at Skoura Palmeraie.

Description:
Situated just 20 minutes away from the buzzing Marrakech, Kasbah Agafay is nested into a majestic environment and offers a refined and elegant accommodation. You will find a huge outside Pool, Spa and a traditional Hamman. You can relax during our Yoga classes, discover the secrets of the Moroccan gastronomy with our cooking classes led by Bouchra, our traditional cook with gold in her hands.  Be tempted by the discovery of the countryside on foot, on horseback, on camel or with a quad.  
Our rooms and suites are decorated with love. They associate the traditional moroccan architecture with a contemporary twist. Some of our rooms have a private terrace with a view onto the Atlas Mountain. Our humble house reflects the richness of the history of Moroccan architecture and traditions and is a real part of the local patrimony. You will be hosted as a friend and our team will make every effort to ensure your comfort and peace.
Our biggest pleasure will be to please you. There is no schedule at Kasbah Agafay. You are free to take your meals whenever you like; either in our restaurant Al Ourda, on the pool side or on one of our terrace. You will feel at home with us. You can also combine a few nights at the Kasbah with our sister property Ksour Agafay located into the Medina, a few minutes from the Jamaa el Fna market place. You will be able to take advantage of the excitement of the city and the quietness of the country.

Description:
This hotel is located at the entrance to the Medina in Tangier. It is a popular spot amongst locals and visitors and offers an enchanting mix of flavours, colours and new impressions. The supermarket is a 5-minute walk and it is around 15 minutes to Bolevar and the Paseo Maritimo. The Medina is approximately 20 minutes away.

This charming, family-friendly hotel is set between the quiet Mediterranean Sea and the fresh air of the Atlantic Ocean. The region has fantastic weather which is mild and warm in winter and pleasant in summer, and the hotel embodies the very spirit of Tangier's tradition of hospitality. This city property comprises a total of 104 rooms, including 8 suites. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, a cloakroom and a newspaper stand. There is a cafe, a bar, a pub and a disco. Guests will appreciate the wireless Internet access and they can also take advantage of the room and laundry services. There is a car park and covered garage parking for those arriving by car.

The ambiance created by the cosy carpets in the hallways that lead to the rooms and suites emanates luxury, discretion and good taste. The interiors are decorated in ochre, ivory and all kinds of earthy tones and feature an Art Deco style. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a bathtub and a hairdryer and offer a double bed. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio, Internet access and a safe. Furthermore, a minibar/fridge, an ironing set and individually regulated air conditioning and heating are provided in all accommodation as standard. All are soundproofed and feature either a balcony or a terrace.

The riad is a calm and charming guesthouse with 5 bedrooms and 3 suites with a freshwater swimming pool. It is nestled in the heart of a 19-hectare farm surrounded by orange, olive and banana trees. The guesthouse is air-conditioned and welcomes guests in a lobby with currency exchange facilities, a TV lounge, children's playground, a café and a restaurant. Guests can relax on the sunbathing terrace and the patio or refresh themselves in the swimming pool. They can also ask to visit the farm surrounding the riad or take cooking lessons (for a fee). The bedrooms of the riad are quiet and traditionally decorated. They are furnished with double or king-size beds and equipped with a terrace, an en suite bathroom with WC and a shower, satellite TV, a mini fridge, individually regulated air conditioning and heating. An in-room safe is also provided.

Guests can take a dip in the hotel's outdoor swimming pool and refreshments are available at the poolside snack bar. Sun loungers are laid out on the sun terrace.

The riad offers refined Moroccan cuisine, accompanied by homemade bread, and varies each day depending on the season, the markets and the guests' cravings.

Located in Taroudant, Dar Randigaba features a terrace with seating area and a Moroccan living room. Free Wi-Fi is available onsite.

On the 1st floor - 1 double 1 triple 1 single
On the second floor - 1 double 1 triple

Each floor also boasts a generous communal area, with a large glass skylight bringing glorious amounts of daylight through the centre of the building, making for perfect relaxing spaces. From the rooftop there are views of the spectacular Atlas Mountains and you can swing in hammocks and listen to the hustle and bustle of street life below.

The things that really set this property apart though, are the small touches, such as the freshly ground coffee and squeezed orange juice every morning. The host is also passionate about music and art, so offers a vinyl player and collection of records for communal use, along with plenty of books to borrow. Beautiful art has been collected by local and visiting artists and the furnishings are stylish and give the house a modern twist on a traditional Moroccan home.

For an authentic yet comfortable insight into a Moroccan way of living, this is absolutely the place for you.

Hôtel Mandy is located in the quiet village of Malalliene, 7 km from Tetouan, 5 km from the coastal towns of Martil, Cabo Negro, Mdiq and the famous city of Chaouen, 45 km away. In the summer season you can relax in the landscaped pool with free sun loungers, a snack bar and paid Balinese beds. We have a playground for the little ones. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property.

Description:
The camp is 26 km from Zagora M'Hamid where there are restaurants, bars, pubs, public transport and shops. The camp is very well situated in the dunes, being very peaceful, accessible by small cars and at the gateway to the desert. Ouarzazate Airport is approximately 180 km from the hotel.

The camp is the first desert destination because it is located in beautiful dunes that allow visitors who do not have much time to get into the real desert, and have a good idea of what it is like as they will spend a beautiful night in nomad tents. Guests experience the calm and silence of the desert, and enjoy the beautiful starry nights and a ride on the back of a camel. The camp offers the possibility of accommodation in 20 tents with breakfast, lunch and dinner. The camp was renovated in 2009 and has a lobby area, a restaurant and a car park.

The nomad tents are traditional and offer the possibility of single, double and triple accommodation. They are equipped with double beds, mattresses, sheets, blankets and towels. There is also a comfort station with showers and toilets.

The camp offers the possibility to hike in the surrounding area and go on camel rides.

The camp offers breakfast, half board and full board. For the customers who stay more than a night the full board is recomended.

From the city of Zagora, take the main road to M'Hamid, and after 26 km on the left, guests will find the camp.

The camp is located in the sand dunes, 15 km from the town of Zagora, which is the gateway to the desert area for all those who visit the south of Morocco. Access to the public transport network is around 15 km away. Ouarzazate Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 170 km.

The camp comprises 15 fully equipped nomad tents. Modern bathroom facilities are located nearby, with showers and toilets. The place is very quiet and peaceful. The establishment also comprises a lobby and restaurant.

The nomadic tents are made from camel hair, which makes them waterproof. They are equipped with mats, carpets and double mattresses with sheets and blankets.

Here guests will be able to go trekking in the dunes, go on camel rides and take walks to watch the sunrise and sunset.

The camp offers breakfast, half board and full board stays. For customers who stay more than one night, full board is recommended.

Once at the hotel in Zagora Kasbah Asmaa, guests go to the camp by camel, which is included in the price, and the next day they return the same way.
